note: WAEC Financial Accounting round 5 (Round 25 top-up): business entity, matching, prudence, going concern, money measurement; suspense account; errors of commission, original entry and principle; complete omission's nil trial-balance effect; club statement of affairs, subscriptions in arrears, income and expenditure account, bar trading account, accumulated fund; prime cost N80,000; WIP adjustment N3,000 deducted; sales commission outside production cost; bill discounting proceeds, dishonour debit, retirement rebate; admission goodwill in new ratio, realisation account, partner salary to current account, 5% loan interest; debenture interest as expense, dividends from distributable profits, share premium above par, interim dividend; reducing balance N16,000, straight line N10,000, doubtful-debt provision base, outstanding wages liability; returns outward off purchases, mark-up on cost, office depreciation in P&L, overstated closing stock. Scanned against WAEC rounds 1-4, NECO Accounting (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
